# Serviceform AgenticSearch

> Search for any website, powered by a Serviceform search tool: instant results, faceted results pages and AI answers. One script and one stylesheet for a ready-made search, or widgets and headless connectors for a custom one. JavaScript (`@serviceform/agenticsearch`, with React and Vue bindings at `/react` and `/vue`) and PHP (`serviceform/agenticsearch`).

The only value a site needs is its search tool id (public, from the Serviceform dashboard: Tools > Search box > Install). There is no API key.

Minimal setup on any site:

```html
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@serviceform/agenticsearch@0/dist/agenticsearch.min.css">
<div data-sf-agenticsearch data-tool-id="TOOL_ID" data-layout="box" data-search-page="/search"></div>
<div data-sf-agenticsearch data-tool-id="TOOL_ID" data-layout="page"></div>
<script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/@serviceform/agenticsearch@0/dist/agenticsearch.prebuilt.min.js" defer></script>
```

Product page: https://www.serviceform.com/industries/automotive/ai-search/
